title: Deep Learning Diagnostics Pipeline
description: Building end-to-end clinical AI pipelines that fuse histopathology imaging, radiology scans, and structured tabular patient records. Applies transfer learning, attention mechanisms, and uncertainty quantification to produce interpretable diagnostic outputs.

title: Agentic AI Orchestration Framework
description: Designing a modular agentic system integrating Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming, RAG microservices for knowledge retrieval, neuro-symbolic reasoning modules, and a Human-in-the-Loop interface for audit and intervention.

title: Neuro-Symbolic IDS for Apache Log Anomaly Detection
description: Intrusion detection system combining deep neural anomaly scoring with symbolic temporal logic reasoning. Maps detected threats to MITRE ATT&CK entries via OWL ontologies with LTL-based multi-stage attack reasoning on CICIDS 2017.

title: Systematic Review Automation Platform
description: AI-assisted platform for systematic literature review — automating database querying across Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore, applying PRISMA-compliant screening, and generating synthesis reports via LLM pipelines.
